facts.statement: The holotype of Nyasasaurus was collected in the 1930s from the Lifua Member of the Manda Formation in southern Tanzania by Francis Rex Parrington.
facts.quote: In the 1930s, the holotype of Nyasasaurus was collected in Parrington's locality B36 from the Lifua Member of the Manda Formation, Ruhuhu Basin near Lake Nyasa in southern Tanzania by Francis Rex Parrington.

facts.statement: The remains were first described in 1956 in a doctoral thesis and referred to as Specimen 50b.
facts.quote: The remains were first described in English paleontologist Alan J. Charig's 1956 doctoral thesis and referred to as "Specimen 50b".

facts.statement: A new description was published in 2013 by Sterling Nesbitt, Paul Barrett, Sarah Werning, and Christian Sidor, which ensured the validity of the name Nyasasaurus and changed the specific name to parringtoni in honor of Parrington.
facts.quote: In 2013 a new description was published by Sterling Nesbitt, Paul Barrett, Sarah Werning and Christian Sidor, including the late Charig as posthumous co-author, ensuring the validity of the name Nyasasaurus, though the specific name was changed to parringtoni, in honour of Parrington.

facts.statement: The generic name refers to Lake Nyasa and the specific name honors Alfred Crompton.
facts.quote: The generic name referred to Lake Nyasa and the specific name honouring Alfred Crompton.

facts.statement: The name Thecodontosaurus alophos was coined for a specimen by Haughton in 1932.
facts.quote: The name Thecodontosaurus alophos was coined for this specimen by Haughton (1932).

facts.statement: Nesbitt et al. (2013) suggested abandoning the name Thecodontosaurus alophos because the specimen lacks diagnostic features and referring it to Nyasasaurus parringtoni.
facts.quote: Nesbitt et al. (2013) found the specimen to not be diagnostic because it does not have any autapomorphic features or a unique combination of characteristics. Therefore, they suggested to abandon the name Thecodontosaurus alophos and to refer its specimen to Nyasasaurus parringtoni.

facts.statement: Analysis of the humerus indicates rapid bone growth with interwoven fibers, many blood vessel channels, and few lines of arrested growth.
facts.quote: An analysis of the interior structure of the humerus indicates that bone growth was rapid, with interwoven bone fibers, many channels for blood vessels that radiate in all directions, and few lines of arrested growth.

facts.statement: The taxon is classified as Nyasasaurus.
facts.quote: taxon: Nyasasaurus

facts.statement: The authority for the genus is Nesbitt et al., 2013.
facts.quote: authority: Nesbitt et al., 2013

facts.statement: The type species is Nyasasaurus parringtoni.
facts.quote: type_species: Nyasasaurus parringtoni

facts.statement: Synonyms include Nyasaurus (White, 1973) and Thecodontosaurus alophos (Haughton, 1932 in part).
facts.quote: synonyms: Nyasaurus White, 1973 (sic) Thecodontosaurus alophos Haughton, 1932 (in part)

facts.statement: Nyasasaurus is confidently classified within Archosauria and Dinosauriformes, and possibly within Dinosauria.
facts.quote: It can be placed confidently within Archosauria, the clade of reptiles represented today by crocodilians and birds, Dinosauriformes, the clade that includes birds, dinosaurs, and several non-dinosaurian groups from the Triassic, and possibly within Dinosauria, the clade of dinosaurs.

facts.statement: The humerus of Nyasasaurus does not share any unique traits exclusively with any other Triassic archosaur clade.
facts.quote: The humerus does not share any synapomorphies exclusively with any other Triassic archosaur clade.

facts.statement: When a second specimen was added to phylogenetic analysis, Nyasasaurus was found to be a theropod.
facts.quote: When SAM-PK-K10654 was added to the analysis, it was found to be a theropod.

facts.statement: In 2021, researchers suggested that the position of Nyasasaurus within Dinosauriformes is uncertain based on shared characteristics with Teleocrater.
facts.quote: In 2021, Fernando Novas and colleagues used the aforementioned characteristics shared by Nyasasaurus and Teleocrater—and not by dinosauriforms such as Asilisaurus and Silesaurus—to suggest that a position for Nyasasaurus in the Dinosauriformes is uncertain.

facts.statement: Nyasasaurus is classified within the unranked order Dinosauromorpha.
facts.quote: unranked_ordo: Dinosauromorpha

facts.statement: Nyasasaurus is classified within the unranked family Dinosauriformes.
facts.quote: unranked_familia: Dinosauriformes

facts.statement: The genus Nyasasaurus was named by Nesbitt et al. in 2012.
facts.quote: genus_authority: Nesbitt et al., 2012

facts.statement: The species Nyasasaurus parringtoni was named by Nesbitt et al. in 2012.
facts.quote: species_authority: Nesbitt et al., 2012

facts.statement: Thecodontosaurus alophos, described by Haughton in 1932, is a potential synonym of Nyasasaurus parringtoni.
facts.quote: synonyms: ¿Thecodontosaurus alophos? Haughton, 1932

facts.statement: Nyasasaurus lived approximately 243 million years ago during the Anisian stage of the Middle Triassic in what is now Africa.
facts.quote: que vivió hace aproximadamente 243 millones de años en mediados del período Triásico, durante el Anisiense, en lo que es hoy África.

facts.statement: If radiometric dating is correct, Nyasasaurus would be Carnian in age, significantly reducing the time gap between it and other early dinosaurs.
facts.quote: If the former is true, this would mean that the Manda Formation, including Nyasasaurus, is actually Carnian in age, drastically reducing the temporal gap between Nyasasaurus and other putative early dinosaurs.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Nyasasaurus indicates a length of 2 to 3 meters.
facts.quote: El espécimen tipo, NHMUK R6856, indica una longitud de 2 a 3 metros.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen consists of a right humerus and six vertebrae, including three partial sacral vertebrae and three presacral vertebrae.
facts.quote: Consiste en un húmero derecho y seis vértebras, tres vértebras sacras parciales y tres vértebras presacras.

facts.statement: A second specimen, SAM-PKK10654, consists of five vertebrae, three cervical vertebrae, and two posterior presacral vertebrae.
facts.quote: Se conoce un segundo espécimen, SAM-PKK10654 que consiste en cinco vértebras, tres vértebras cervicales y dos vértebras presacras posteriores.

facts.statement: The internal bone structure of Nyasasaurus resembles that of the primitive dinosaur Coelophysis more than dinosaur ancestors, suggesting it was closer to dinosaur ancestry than other archosaurs of the time.
facts.quote: Esta estructura coincide más con la del dinosaurio primitivo Coelophysis que con los ancestros de los dinosaurios, lo que sugiere que Nyasasaurus estaba más cerca de la ascendencia de los dinosaurios que otros arcosaurios en ese momento.

facts.statement: A 1986 hypothesis suggested Nyasasaurus was a primitive prosauropod dinosaur, but this was disputed.
facts.quote: Nyasasaurus was suggested to have been a primitive prosauropod dinosaur in 1986, but this hypothesis was disputed.

facts.statement: Not all paleontologists accept the younger Carnian age proposed for the formation containing Nyasasaurus.
facts.quote: Not all paleontologists are convinced by this, however.

facts.statement: The SHRIMP dating methods used to determine the age of the Río Seco de la Quebrada Formation have been criticized as less accurate than CA-TIMS dating.
facts.quote: The dating methods used for finding the age of the RSQ have also been criticized based on the argument that SHRIMP dating is less accurate than CA-TIMS dating.

facts.statement: A 2012 analysis suggested Nyasasaurus could be the oldest known dinosaur, predating Herrerasaurus and Eoraptor by about 15 million years.
facts.quote: En un análisis cladistico de 2012 se sugiere que puede ser un dinosaurio, hecho que lo constituiría en el más antiguo conocido, superando en unos 15 million years ago a Herrerasaurus y Eoraptor.

facts.statement: The presacral vertebrae of Nyasasaurus specimens are similar to those of the enigmatic avemetatarsalian archosaur Teleocrater rhadinus.
facts.quote: El estudio también mencionó la similitud entre las vértebras presacras de ambos ejemplares de Nyasasaurus parringtoni y las del enigmático arcosaurio avemetatarsaliano, Teleocrater rhadinus.

facts.statement: Fossils of Nyasasaurus were collected in the 1930s by Francis Rex Parrington from the Parrington B36 locality in the Manda Formation near Lake Nyasa in southern Tanzania.
facts.quote: En los fósiles de la década de 1930 recuperados en la localidad Parrington B36 del Miembro Lifua de la Formación Manda, Cuenca Ruhuhu cerca del lago Nyasa, en el sur de Tanzania, por Francis Rex Parrington.

facts.statement: The remains were first described in a 1956 doctoral thesis by English paleontologist Alan J. Charig, who named the specimen "Specimen 50b".
facts.quote: Los restos se describieron por primera vez en la tesis doctoral de 1956 del paleontólogo inglés Alan J. Charig y se denominaron "Especimen 50b".

facts.statement: Charig used the name Nyasasaurus parringtoni in 1967 in a review of Archosauria without a formal description, leading it to be commonly considered a nomen nudum.
facts.quote: En 1967 Charig usó el nombre Nyasasaurus parringtoni, en una reseña de Archosauria, pero sin ninguna descripción, por lo que comúnmente se consideraba un nomen nudum.

facts.statement: A new description was published in 2012 by Sterling Nesbitt, Paul Barrett, Sarah Werning, and Christian Sidor, which included Charig as a posthumous co-author and validated the name.
facts.quote: En 2012, Sterling Nesbitt, Paul Barrett, Sarah Werning y Christian Sidor publicaron una nueva descripción, incluyendo a Charig como coautor póstumo, asegurando la validez de su nombre.

facts.statement: The generic name refers to Lake Nyasa, and the specific name honors Parrington.
facts.quote: El nombre genérico se refiere al lago Nyasa y el nombre específico en honor a Parrington.

facts.statement: The name Thecodontosaurus alophos was coined for this specimen by Haughton in 1932.
facts.quote: El nombre Thecodontosaurus alophos fue acuñado para este espécimen por Haughton en 1932.

facts.statement: In 2013, Nesbitt and colleagues found that the Thecodontosaurus alophos sample was not diagnostic because it lacked any autapomorphic features or a unique combination of traits.
facts.quote: Nesbitt et al. en 2013 encontraron que la muestra no era diagnóstica porque no tiene ninguna característica autapomórfica o una combinación única de características.

facts.statement: Nyasasaurus can be securely placed within Archosauria, Dinosauria, and possibly Dinosauriformes.
facts.quote: Se puede ubicar con seguridad dentro de Archosauria, el grupo de reptiles representado hoy por los cocodrilos y las aves, Dinosauria, el grupo de los dinosaurios y posiblemente dentro de Dinosauriformes, el grupo que incluye aves, dinosaurios no aviares y varios grupos no dinosaurios del Triásico.

facts.statement: It was suggested that Nyasasaurus was a primitive prosauropod dinosaur, but this hypothesis is questionable.
facts.quote: Se sugirió que el Nyasasaurus había sido un dinosaurio prosaurópodo primitivo, pero esta hipótesis es cuestionable.

facts.statement: A 2012 analysis suggests Nyasasaurus may be the oldest known dinosaur, dating to the Middle Triassic or late Anisian age, about 243 million years ago, 10 million years before other dinosaur species like Herrerasaurus.
facts.quote: El análisis del 2012 sugiere que Nyasasaurus puede ser el dinosaurio conocido más antiguo, datándose durante el Triásico medio a finales de la edad anisiense, hace unos 243 million years ago, 10 million years ago antes que cualquier otra especie de dinosaurio, como el Herrerasaurus.

facts.statement: However, this age is being questioned in recent articles.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, esta edad está siendo cuestionada en artículos recientes.

facts.statement: Affinities with dinosaurs have been tested based on a long deltopectoral crest on the humerus with a deviated upper part, a feature unequivocally present only in dinosaurs.
facts.quote: Se han probado afinidades con los dinosaurios por la larga cresta deltopectoral en el húmero, con una parte superior desviada, una parte superior inequívocamente de dinosaurio, otra característica presente solo en los dinosaurios.

facts.statement: Nyasasaurus is considered a basal dinosaur or close to dinosaurs.
facts.quote: Nyasasaurus es un dinosaurio basal o próximo a los dinosaurios.

facts.statement: A 2017 phylogenetic analysis by Matthew Baron, David B. Norman, and Paul Barrett found that Nyasasaurus may represent a derived sauropodomorph more closely related to masospondylines like Massospondylus and Lufengosaurus.
facts.quote: Un gran análisis filogenético de los primeros dinosaurios y dinosauriomorfos realizado por Matthew Baron, David B. Norman y Paul Barrett en 2017 encontró que Nyasasaurus puede representar un miembro derivado de Sauropodomorpha más estrechamente relacionado con Masospóndilos como Massospondylus y Lufengosaurus.

facts.statement: The parent group of Nyasasaurus is listed as Dinosauria.
facts.quote: Parent group: Dinosauria

facts.statement: The type species of the genus Nyasasaurus is Nyasasaurus cromptoni.
facts.quote: Type species: Nyasasaurus cromptoni
